chunks: A half of it or a little less
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on taking half or slightly less of a specified amount?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this fragment is often interpreted within the context of financial obligations or ritual shares, emphasizing precision in legal calculations. Scholars note that the option to reduce the half slightly allows for flexibility in cases of hardship or to ensure the recipient receives a net benefit after deductions, reflecting the juristic principle of ease (taysir).
